From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>

Cc: Samir Bose <samir.bose@luminalabs.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Deployment mode selection & migration plan - Lumina Labs

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the demo and the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Recap of needs (from our call):
- Current setup: primary usage on OpenAI API for experiments + an internal legacy GPU cluster for on-prem model runs.
- Key requirements: US data residency, SOC 2 evidence, <200ms P95 for customer-facing chat, sustained throughput ~50 req/s for peak flows, and ability to run internal models in a private environment for PHI.
- Migration drivers: cost predictability, stronger observability, and consolidation of routing/fallbacks across model variants.

What we discussed as deployment options:
- Hosted API: fastest path for initial rollout, lower ops overhead, but not suitable for PHI / strict data residency without dedicated controls.
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pool; predictable throughput and isolation, good intermediate step for predictable SLAs and better cost economics than ad-hoc cloud endpoints.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): required if Lumina needs customer-data-isolated VPC, KMS/HSM integration, and on-prem model hosting for regulated PHI pipelines.

Immediate next steps I recommend:
1) Please share your recent 30-day usage pattern (tokens/calls by endpoint), and the architecture diagram you mentioned (attachments).
2) We’ll propose two MAP options: (A) 6-week pilot on Dedicated capacity to validate throughput and latency (fastest to production-like), (B) technical scoping for Private VPC/on-prem (longer lead, security review).
3) Schedule a technical deep-dive with our infra lead (Dev Patel) to walk through network/KMS requirements and pilot sizing.
4) I’ll also send our SOC 2 artifact and a preliminary Dedicated sizing doc for review.

Proposed times for the technical deep-dive: next Tue/Wed 10–12 PT or Thu 2–4 PT — what works for your engineers?

Attachments: arch-v1.png (architecture diagram)

Thanks — happy to adapt based on Samir’s and your engineering priorities.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa — this is excellent, and the recap matches our notes. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We do have PHI in a subset of customer workflows, so Private/VPC is our preference long-term. That said, we'd be open to a Dedicated pilot as an intermediate step so we can validate latency/cost before committing to an on-prem project.
- Timeline: we'd like to ramp before Q4; pilot ideally in July. Budget: mid-six-figures annual for a committed Dedicated setup is on the table if the performance numbers match.
- Current infra: we run two main flows — inference via OpenAI for research and an internal cluster (NVIDIA A100 nodes) for our proprietary models. We want routing to support both external API fallbacks and local model hosting.

I attached the architecture diagram (arch-v1.png) and added Samir (our Head of ML Ops) to the thread — he’ll be the main technical contact.

Samir — can you confirm your availability for a deep-dive next week and whether you prefer Dedicated pilot vs. starting a Private scoping exercise?

Thanks,

Emily / Samir —

Thanks for the quick reply and for the architecture diagram — helpful. I've attached our SOC 2 summary and a preliminary Dedicated sizing doc (redwood-dedicated-sizing.pdf) that maps your stated throughput to a recommended reserved footprint. High-level notes below: 

Preliminary sizing & recommendations (subject to the deep-dive):
- If your peak is ~50 req/s (chat-style interactions) with per-request ~500 tokens, we recommend starting with a 2x g5.12 (or equivalent) reserved pool with auto-burst enabled; this gives predictable latency while we tune batching and KV cache.
- For PHI-sensitive flows: Private/VPC is the recommended final state. We can run a Dedicated pilot that connects to your VPC via a secure peering/VPN for initial live traffic tests, then transition to Private if you proceed.
- KMS: we support Bring-Your-Own keys (AWS KMS/GCP KMS/HSM). Our security team can send an architecture checklist for Samir to review.

Proposed immediate next steps: 
1) Technical deep-dive: Wednesday Jul 7, 10:00 PT (Dev + Rachel + Samir) — I'll calendar invite once you confirm.
2) Exchange of artifacts: I attached SOC 2 summary (redwood-soc2.pdf) and Dedicated sizing doc. Please send us a 30-day usage export and any redlines/constraints from your security/compliance team.
3) MAP: we’ll draft a 6-week Dedicated pilot scope (objectives, success metrics, rollback plan) and a parallel Private scoping plan for long-term work.

If you prefer, we can also prepare a price/commitment comparison: Hosted API (pay-as-you-go) vs Dedicated (committed) vs Private (license + on-prem).

Thanks — looping in Dev and Rachel to coordinate the technical deep-dive.

Best,
Marissa

Marissa / Rachel / Emily / Samir —

I reviewed the diagram and Marissa’s sizing notes. A few technical items I'd like to capture ahead of the deep-dive so we can scope properly: 

1) Network & VPC connectivity: if we do Dedicated pilot with VPC peering, we need the target CIDR ranges, egress rules, and whether a private endpoint is required for management plane.
2) KMS: confirm key rotation and whether you need HSM-backed keys for PHI. We can support AWS KMS + external HSM, but need requirements up front.
3) Model artifacts & formats: will you serve containerized models from your registry or ask us to serve from a model repo? If you need on-prem, we need details on GPU types and air-gapped constraints.
4) Telemetry & logging: provide sample request/response logs (sanitized) so we can validate trace/span naming and cost breakdowns.

For the Dedicated pilot, rough success criteria we should include in the MAP:
- P95 latency <200ms for the pilot endpoints under a 50 req/s synthetic test.
- End-to-end deploy time for model variants <30m (including KV warm-up).
- Validated KMS integration and encryption-at-rest verification.

I’ll prepare a quick internal checklist and a list of pre-deep-dive artifacts to send to Samir.

Thanks — I’m available Wed Jul 7 at 10:00 PT for the deep-dive.

—Dev
